name: Herdr
note: A terminal workspace manager that hosts other agents. Its sessions come from `herdr api snapshot`, the same socket API its own CLI reads, rather than from the session file on disk — the file is written on change and lags a running pane. Each row is one pane, so two agents in one tab stay two rows. Focus goes through `herdr tab focus`: a tab holds several panes, and raising the terminal application instead would land on whichever tab was last in front. The process rule matches the executable name exactly: a path fragment of /herdr also matches a directory called herdrly, which the negative installation probe caught.

installationProbes.method: collision: a directory whose name starts with herdr
installationProbes.name: node

compatibility.note: Read through the documented socket API; validate against a running instance with --check.
